test_overview: Evaluated the ComfortPro Connect job rescheduling test plan end-to-end using three isolated browser contexts (context_client = Jane Doe/Client, context_tech_A = Sam Turner/Technician A, context_tech_B = Ivy Kim/Technician B). Server was accessible on APPLICATION_PORT 8000. Step 1: Signed up Jane as Client and created a booking (Plumbing/Residential/Repair/Standard, 350 N Orleans St, Chicago IL 60654, preferred 2026-08-22 AM). Confirmation showed Booking ID #1. Signed up Sam as Technician; booking appeared in 'All Service Bookings'; converted it to Job with schedule 2026-08-22 AM. Job #1 showed Status Scheduled and Technician Sam Turner. Step 2: Signed up Ivy as Technician; her Jobs list showed 'No jobs yet.' and Bookings list 'No active bookings.' — Job #1 not visible to the non-assigned technician. Step 3: As Sam, Job status was Scheduled; used the 'Reschedule Job' modal to set date 2026-08-23 and PM; success toast shown and Job Information updated to ' Aug 23, 2026 at PM'; navigating to Jobs list and back preserved the new schedule. Step 4: Changed status to In Progress via the status dropdown (success toast); the Reschedule control was no longer rendered on the job detail page (control hidden = reschedule not allowed). Step 5: Added work note 'Cleared drain and tested.' (success toast; note listed), changed status to Completed; Reschedule control again not rendered (control hidden = reschedule not allowed). All verifications passed.

steps.description: test_setup_booking_and_job: Jane (Client) signed up and created booking #1 (Plumbing/Residential/Repair/Standard, 350 N Orleans St, Chicago IL 60654, 2026-08-22 AM) - 'Service Request Submitted!' confirmation with Booking ID #1. Sam Turner (Technician) signed up, saw the booking, converted it to Job #1 scheduled 2026-08-22 AM. Job showed Status Scheduled and Technician Sam Turner. All verifications passed.

test_non_assigned_technician_cannot_see_job: Ivy Kim (Technician B) signed up and opened Jobs list - 'No jobs yet.' shown, Job #1 not visible. Bookings list also showed 'No active bookings.' Job visible only to assigned technician. Passed.

test_reschedule_available_when_scheduled: As Sam, Job #1 status Scheduled. Reschedule modal opened with current schedule 'Aug 22, 2026 at AM'; set 2026-08-23 PM and saved. Toast 'Job rescheduled to Aug 23, 2026 at PM' and Job Information updated accordingly. After navigating to Jobs list and back, the updated schedule persisted. Passed.

test_reschedule_unavailable_when_in_progress: Changed status to In Progress via UI status dropdown (success toast; status displayed In Progress). Attempted to reschedule - the Reschedule Job button/section was no longer rendered (control hidden). Acceptable outcome. Passed.

test_reschedule_unavailable_when_completed: Added note 'Cleared drain and tested.' (success toast; note shown). Changed status to Completed (success toast; status displayed Completed). Attempted to reschedule/edit schedule - the Reschedule control was not rendered on the completed job page (control hidden). Acceptable outcome. Passed.
